## Problem and behavior

Closes #<ticket>

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

Commands/checks run and relevant browser evidence. Separate unverified behavior.

## Compatibility and risks

Template/expression/unit changes, migrations, deployment effects or remaining limitations.

## Checklist

- [ ] Linked ticket and acceptance criteria are addressed.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior and relevant failure cases.
- [ ] CLI/help/docs and agent instructions match the change.
- [ ] No private engineering files, snapshots, credentials or generated project results are included.
- [ ] Calculation/package validation is not presented as Prime verification or engineering approval.
